attachmentFile.description: Url of the attachment file. Only available if the campaign has an attachment.

abTesting.description: Status of A/B Test for the campaign. abTesting = false means it is disabled, & abTesting = true means it is enabled.

previewText.description: Preview text or preheader of the email campaign

scheduledAt.description: UTC date-time on which campaign is scheduled (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

sendAtBestTime.description: It is true if you have chosen to send your campaign at best time, otherwise it is false

splitRule.description: The size of your ab-test groups. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`

subject.description: Subject of the campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `false`

subjectA.description: Subject A of the ab-test campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`

subjectB.description: Subject B of the ab-test campaign. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`

winnerCriteria.description: Criteria for the winning version. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`

winnerDelay.description: The duration of the test in hours at the end of which the winning version will be sent. Only available if `abTesting` flag of the campaign is `true`

attachmentUrl.description: URL of the attachment file associated with the campaign. Empty string if no attachment is present.

createdAt.description: Creation UTC date-time of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

emailExpirationDate.description: Expiration date configuration for the email campaign, if set. Contains the duration and unit of the email expiry.

inlineImageActivation.description: Status of inline image. inlineImageActivation = false means image can’t be embedded, & inlineImageActivation = true means image can be embedded, in the email.

mirrorActive.description: Status of mirror links in campaign. mirrorActive = false means mirror links are deactivated, & mirrorActive = true means mirror links are activated, in the campaign

modifiedAt.description: UTC date-time of last modification of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

recurring.description: FOR TRIGGER ONLY ! Type of trigger campaign.recurring = false means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign only once, & recurring = true means contact can receive the same Trigger campaign several times

replyTo.description: Email defined as the "Reply to" of the campaign

returnBounce.description: Total number of non-delivered campaigns for a particular campaign id.

sentDate.description: Sent UTC date-time of the campaign (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ). Only available if 'status' of the campaign is 'sent'

shareLink.description: Link to share the campaign on social media. For trigger campaigns, this returns a descriptive message instead of a URL. For classic campaigns that have not been sent, this also returns a descriptive message.

tags.description: List of tags of the campaign

testSent.description: Retrieved the status of test email sending. (true=Test email has been sent  false=Test email has not been sent)

toField.description: Customisation of the "to" field of the campaign

utmCampaignValue.description: The utm_campaign value associated with the campaign. Only present if a UTM campaign value was set.

utmContent.description: The utm_content value associated with the campaign. Only present if a utm_content value was set on create or update.

utmID.description: The campaign ID used as utm_id parameter. Only present if UTM campaign tracking with ID is enabled.

utmMedium.description: The utm_medium value. Set to "EMAIL" when UTM campaign tracking is enabled.

utmSource.description: The utm_source value. Set to "Brevo" when UTM campaign tracking is enabled.

utmTerm.description: The utm_term value associated with the campaign. Only present if a utm_term value was set on create or update.

EmailCampaignsCampaignIdGetResponsesCont.description: Expiration date configuration for the email campaign, if set. Contains the duration and unit of the email expiry.
EmailCampaignsCampaignIdGetResponsesCont.title: EmailCampaignsCampaignIdGetResponsesContentApplicationJsonSchemaEmailExpirationDate

desktop.description: Statistics of the campaign on the basis of desktop devices

mobile.description: Statistics of the campaign on the basis of mobile devices

tablet.description: Statistics of the campaign on the basis of tablet devices

unknown.description: Statistics of the campaign on the basis of unknown devices

excludedSegments.description: Segment IDs excluded from the campaign

segments.description: Segment IDs included in the campaign

appleMppOpens.description: Numbers of times your email has been opened automatically through Apple MPP.

clickers.description: Number of total clicks for the campaign

complaints.description: Number of complaints (Spam reports) for the campaign

deferred.description: Number of deferred emails for the campaign

delivered.description: Number of delivered emails for the campaign

estimatedViews.description: Rate of recipients without any privacy protection option enabled in their email client, applied to all delivered emails

hardBounces.description: Number of hard bounces for the campaign

listId.description: List Id of email campaign (only in case of get email campaign(s)(not for global stats))

opensRate.title: float
opensRate.description: Percentage of recipients who open the email out of your total number of recipients. Depending on your Campaign settings, they may include Apple MPP opens.

returnBounce.description: Total number of non-delivered campaigns for a particular campaign id.

sent.description: Number of sent emails for the campaign

softBounces.description: Number of softbounce for the campaign

trackableViews.description: Recipients without any privacy protection option enabled in their email email client

trackableViewsRate.title: float
trackableViewsRate.description: Rate of recipients without any privacy protection option enabled in their email client

uniqueClicks.description: Number of unique clicks for the campaign

uniqueViews.description: Number of unique openings for the campaign

unsubscriptions.description: Number of unsubscription for the campaign

viewed.description: Number of openings for the campaign

clickers.description: Number of total clicks for the campaign using the particular browser

uniqueClicks.description: Number of unique clicks for the campaign using the particular browser

uniqueViews.description: Number of unique openings for the campaign using the particular browser

viewed.description: Number of openings for the campaign using the particular browser

linksStats.description: Statistics about the number of clicks for each link in the campaign. Keys are the link URLs, values are click counts. Only populated when the `statistics` query parameter is set to `linksStats`.

mirrorClick.description: Number of clicks on mirror link

remaining.description: Number of remaining emails to send

statsByBrowser.description: Statistics of the campaign grouped by browser. Only available when retrieving a single campaign with the `statistics` query parameter set to `statsByBrowser`.

statsByDomain.description: Statistics of the campaign grouped by email domain. Only populated when the `statistics` query parameter is set to `statsByDomain`.
